settings.autoBuildInstantFreeDesc: Automatically completes the active building upgrade for free when the 3-minute free window opens.
settings.autoDailyBonusDesc: Automatically collects the daily login bonus whenever available. Schedules itself for the next day after collecting.
settings.buildingQueueAllDesc: Shows all potential upgrades, including those limited by resources. Supports local fake queues.
settings.buildingQueueDesc: Manage your building queue and upgrades directly from the overview screen.
settings.ctxAttackButtonsDesc: Shows quick-send attack buttons in the map context menu based on your troop templates. Clicking a village opens template buttons for instant attacks.
settings.antibot.cache.desc: Configure how long overview data stays cached before the script fetches it again.
settings.antibot.cache.label: Cache intervals
settings.antibot.cache.overviewMain.desc: How long village main data stays cached before the next fetch.
settings.antibot.cache.overviewTroops.de: How long troop counts stay cached before the next fetch.
settings.antibot.disableOnDetection.desc: Keeps the script disabled as soon as the anti-bot screen is detected. Leave this on unless you explicitly want the script to stay active.
settings.antibot.disableOnDetection.labe: Disable all features when Anti-Bot is detected
settings.antibot.offlineMode.desc: Disables player-facing fetches while bot scripts keep running.
settings.antibot.offlineMode.label: Offline mode
settings.heatmapReportsDesc: Overlays a colour-coded heat-map on the map based on attack reports. Intensity reflects frequency and recency.
settings.hidePremiumAdsDesc: Removes all premium promotional banners and intrusive advertisements from the interface.
settings.keepAwakeDesc: Automatically refreshes the page after 5 minutes of inactivity to prevent timeout.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language used across the script's interface.
settings.mapCommandOverlayDesc: Displays outgoing command icons directly on the map.
settings.mapHoverDesc: Reveals detailed village information when hovering over the map.
settings.navigationArrowsDesc: Adds arrows to the UI for faster switching between your villages.
settings.navigationBarDesc: The customizable quick access bar appears at the top of the screen and allows you to speed up your gaming experience. Navigate anywhere or run a script with just one click!
settings.notepadDesc: Adds a village-specific notepad for personalized notes and reminders. All notes are also accessible on the Notepad page.
settings.overviewVillagesQueueDesc: Adds a Build Queue column to the multi-village overview table, showing each village's active build queue.
settings.overviewVillagesQuicklinksDesc: Adds an icon to each village that opens a popup with shortcut icons for that village.
settings.overviewVillagesTroopsDesc: Adds a Troops column to the multi-village overview table, using cached unit counts (only refreshed when that village's train page was last visited). Includes a refresh button to update all villages' troops.
settings.playerProfileStatsDesc: Adds extra player stats sourced from TWStats (average points/village, tribe changes, conquers, best rank/points/villages, OD ranking, other worlds) to the player profile page.
settings.recruitTroopsDesc: Enables a troop recruitment panel on the overview page.
settings.redirectTrainBuildingsDesc: Directly opens the recruitment screen when clicking on training-related buildings.
settings.softDarkModeDesc: Applies a subtle darker theme across the interface while preserving readability, borders and game icons.
settings.storageTimerDesc: Shows the time remaining until your storage is full when hovering over resources.
settings.title: Script Settings
settings.villageListDesc: Displays a quick-access list of your villages on the overview screen.
settings.visualBuildingOverviewDesc: Provides a graphical overview of building levels, similar to Premium Account features.
